Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
GAME: Oxygen Not Included, colony 'The Ramshackle Colony'. Cycle 5 at last view; dupe count fell from ~5 to 2 (at least one death; 'High stress (2)' alert). Duplicant names seen: Bubbles, Nails, Gossmann, Ashkan, Ada (inconsistent). Earlier the counter reset to Cycle 1 (possible restart); it has climbed to Cycle 4-5 since. Oxygen meter fell to 0% then recovered steadily: 50s -> 54 -> 57 -> 61 -> 65 -> 69 -> 72% while two alert types persisted. So local oxygen recovery happened WITHOUT a built diffuser (observed), cause unverified.

UI CONTROLS / COORDINATES (1280x720; normalized = px/1280, px/720):
- Pause/unpause ~(0.094,0.079); tooltip 'Pause [SPACE]' means running, 'Unpause [SPACE]' means paused. Confirmed running at last check.
- Red Alert toggle ~(0.179,0.078); tooltip 'Toggle Red Alert - Duplicants will work, ignoring schedules and their basic needs'. Successfully toggled OFF (its alert entry vanished, dark red tint lifted). Earlier a click at x0.18 hit water instead - hover first.
- Bottom-left build categories y~0.928: Base ~0.033, Oxygen ~0.06, Power ~0.10, Food ~0.14, Plumbing ~0.185, Ventilation ~0.23.
- Base submenu is FILTERED by a tutorial filter to only Ladder, Tile, Pneumatic Door, Storage Bin. Workaround that worked: click search box ~(0.110,0.561), type letters, click the result icon. Typing keys via control action works.
- Build menu item icons appear ~y0.407-0.41 in the results list (e.g. Outhouse at ~(0.045,0.407)). Clicking an icon once may only show its tooltip; a second click arms placement (observed with Outhouse).
- Bottom-right: Dig ~(0.668,0.93) or hotkey G; Cancel button ~(0.709,0.969) actually opens/keeps the Tool Filter panel (it did not cancel); Deconstruct ~0.745,0.93; Priority ~0.81,0.93. Tool Filter panel occupies roughly x>0.845, y>0.66 and can swallow drags - avoid dragging into it. Escape closes panels (usually).
- Alerts list at x~0.058-0.19, rows ~y0.13-0.19; clicking an alert jumps/zooms the camera.
- Zoom changed with scroll steps (-2/-3 zoomed out, tile ~32 px at that level).

MECHANICS CONFIRMED BY OBSERVATION:
- Nothing progresses while paused; identical resource numbers across turns is the tell.
- Dig/build errands require the target to be usable from a cell dupes can actually stand in/path to; otherwise 'Unreachable Dig'/'Unreachable Build'. Designating gas cells (g values, e.g. 'Carbon Dioxide 1432 g') does nothing - solids read kg.
- Bulk drags far from any standing cell always read 'Unreachable Dig'. Small designations beside a dupe or beside the ladder DID execute (a dupe was seen digging with debris at the ladder base).
- Ladder reach (from reference/notes, not fully verified in game): 2 tiles sideways, 4 up, 3 down; standing dupe roughly 5 wide x 4 high upward.
- Even tiles adjacent to a dupe in the lower cavern once read 'Unreachable' - so PATHING, not just adjacency, may be the true constraint (hypothesis).
- Building successfully buildable on the platform floor: Outhouse, 200 kg Raw Mineral/wood, no piping, consumes Dirt 13 kg/use; needs unoccupied floor cell; 'Must be built in unoccupied space' when overlapping pod/other building. Outhouse was placed right of the pod on the tile bridge ~(0.745,0.497), delivered, built, and 'No Outhouse built' cleared; sandstone went 5.6 t -> 5.4 t.
- Resource list: no Metal Ore line at all (0 kg). Algae ~97-103 kg (was up to 393), Coal 1172.7 kg, Sand ~950-990 kg, Sandstone 5.4 t, Edible fell 14,124 -> 9,205 kcal (dupes eating), Dirt/Algae/Sandstone tiles dominate the reachable rock.

KEY OBJECTS / BLUEPRINTS:
- Oxygen Diffuser BLUEPRINT already exists on the platform right of the pod at ~(0.77,0.472); panel reads 'Insufficient Resources - Copper Ore: 29.5 kg' of the 200 kg needed (so ~170 kg short). It is the source of 'Building lacks resources' and 'No Oxygen Generator built'. A copper block yields ~600 kg, so ONE ore tile would finish it.
- Printing Pod ~(0.688,0.47) reports 'Next Print: UNAVAILABLE - Missing Tile' - it has no floor tile beneath; building a tile under it is an untried fix for restoring new dupes.
- Ladder shaft at x~0.707 (905 px) descends from the platform into a flooded polluted-water/CO2 cavern with food-poisoning germs; built tile bridge x~0.75-0.82 at floor row y~0.55.
- Lower cavern floor is walkable but CO2-filled (Unbreathable) - dupes passing out there is a risk.

FAILED / WASTED STRATEGIES:
- Repeated hubdreds of turns hovering random tiles to find copper ore: found only sand, sandstone, dirt, algae, water, CO2, oxygen. No ore tile ever identified.
- All bulk dig designations on the right-hand rock mass (x 0.84-0.98, and again after zooming) stay 'Unreachable Dig'. Abandoned repeatedly, then retried - still failed.
- Designating a tile whose top is under a solid floor, digs beneath water, and digs 2+ tiles from the platform edge all failed.
- Clicking Cancel expecting cancellation opened the Tool Filter; Escape is the reliable dismissal.
- Resource panel label clicks don't expand; only 'See All' does; scroll wheel doesn't scroll it (drag the scrollbar thumb).

ACTIVE GOAL: finish the Oxygen Diffuser by finding ~170 kg of Copper Ore (only viable path identified). Secondary/unattempted: place one Tile under the Printing Pod to re-enable printing; consider Algae Terrarium as an alternative oxygen source but the Oxygen build menu is filtered to Oxygen Diffuser only and the filter toggles (~(0.023,0.683) and (0.042,0.683)) were never successfully clicked - two attempts rejected as stale.

UNRESOLVED HYPOTHESES (unverified guesses): copper ore veins are the orange-brown speckled tiles in the upper-right/unmined rock (never confirmed by hover); a tunnel dug outward one tile at a time from the platform floor edge would eventually reach ore but each step needs a standing cell; the two 'Building lacks resources' entries are the diffuser plus one other object; a yellow-flagged object at ~(0.688,0.112) in a zoomed view was unidentified.

CURRENT VIEW: zoomed out; platform with pod, built Outhouse and diffuser blueprint; ladder down to a flooded cavern; large unmined rock bodies right and below; 2 dupes alive, oxygen ~72%,
